examples.text: nekatikā vañcanikā, kūṭasakkhī apāṭukā, bahūhi parikappehi, āmisaṃ paribhuñjare.

38701.meaning1: deep concentration in meditation does not arise; one does not attain mental unification
38701.commentary: (SNa) ekattan'ti jhānaṃ. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, kāme ajahitvā muni jhānaṃ na upapajjati, na paṭilabhatī'ti attho.

examples.text: chinda sotaṃ parakkamma, kāme panuda brāhmaṇa, nappahāya munī kāme, n'ekattam'upapajjati.

38702.grammar: ind, adv, from na eka, neg
38702.commentary: (THa) nekadhā hī'ti oṭṭha-goṇa-gadrabh'ādi-vasena c'eva kāka-balāka-kulal'ādi-vasena ca anekappakāraṃ anekavārañ'ca

examples.text: saṃsaraṃ hi nirayaṃ agacchissaṃ, petalokam'agamaṃ punappunaṃ, dukkhamamhi'pi tiracchānayoniyaṃ, n'ekadhā hi vusitaṃ ciraṃ mayā.

38703.grammar: ind, adv, from na eka, neg

38704.meaning1: many years old; accumulated for many years
38704.construction:
neka + vassa + gaṇa + ika
nekavassagaṇa + ika

examples.text: tatrāssu me idaṃ, sāriputta, lūkhasmiṃ hoti, n'ekavassagaṇikaṃ rajojallaṃ kāye sannicitaṃ hoti papaṭikajātaṃ.

38706.meaning2: versed in the five collections of the scriptures, belonging to a sect

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nekkhaṃ jambonadaṃ dakkha-kammāraputta-ukkāmukha-sukusala-sampahaṭṭhaṃ paṇḍukambale nikkhittaṃ bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, satasahasso brahmā satasahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
tatra bhikkhu vivekaninnena cittena vivekapoṇena vivekapabbhārena vivek'aṭṭhena nekkhamma-abhiratena añña'd'atthu uyyojanika-paṭisaṃyuttaṃ'y'eva kathaṃ kattā hoti
kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā, mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ.

38709.meaning1: interest in renunciation; desire to give up sensual pleasure

examples.text: nekkhammadhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammasaññā, nekkhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammasaṅkappo, nekkhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammacchando, nekkhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammapariḷāho, nekkhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammapariyesanā, nekkhammapariyesanaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyesamāno sutavā ariyasāvako tīhi ṭhānehi sammā paṭipajjati, kāyena, vācāya, manasā.

iti nekkhamm'ābhinīhatā tayo chandā, nekkhammacchando abyāpādacchando avihiṃsāchando. tattha nekkhammacchando alobho, abyāpādacchando adoso, avihiṃsāchando amoho. imāni tīṇi kusalamūlāni aṭṭhasu sampattesu parahitāni, tesaṃ'y'eva catunnaṃ upādānānaṃ nirodhāya saṃvattanti.

38710.meaning1: delighting in the desire for renunciation; taking pleasure in the impulse to give up sensual pleasure

examples.text: sace ca pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, nekkhammachand'ābhirato vicakkhaṇo, aggo na so gacchati jātu khambhanaṃ, nar'uttamo esa hi tassa dhammatā'ti.

38713.commentary: (DNa) nekkhammadhātu'ādīsu nekkhammapaṭisaṃyutto takko vitakko sammāsaṅkappo. ayaṃ vuccati nekkhammadhātu. sabbe'pi kusalā dhammā nekkhammadhātū'ti ayaṃ nekkhammadhātu. (SNa) nekkhammadhātuṃ, bhikkhave'ti ettha nekkhammavitakko'pi nekkhammadhātu sabbe'pi kusalā dhammā.

examples.text: cha'y'imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, kāmadhātu, nekkhammadhātu, byāpādadhātu, abyāpādadhātu, vihiṃsādhātu, avihiṃsādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, cha dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

38714.meaning1: mature in renunciation; which has fostered the rejection of sensual pleasure

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti, nekkhammaninnañ'c'assa cittaṃ hoti. nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ kammaniyaṃ khāyati, abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesū'ti.

38715.meaning1: quest for renunciation; searching for the giving up of sensual pleasure

examples.text: nekkhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammapariḷāho, nekkhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammapariyesanā, nekkhammapariyesanaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyesamāno sutavā ariyasāvako tīhi ṭhānehi sammā paṭipajjati, kāyena, vācāya, manasā.

38716.meaning1: fever for renunciation; burning passion for giving up sensual pleasure

examples.text: nekkhammadhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammasaññā, nekkhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammasaṅkappo, nekkhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammacchando, nekkhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammapariḷāho, nekkhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati nekkhammapariyesanā, nekkhammapariyesanaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyesamāno sutavā ariyasāvako tīhi ṭhānehi sammā paṭipajjati, kāyena, vācāya, manasā.

38717.meaning2: highest state of giving up; perfection of renunciation

38718.meaning1: enjoying renunciation (from); taking delight in giving up sensual pleasure
38718.commentary: (THa) kāmehi nekkhammaratan'ti sabbaso kāmehi nikkhamitvā pabbajjā-jhāna-vipassan'ādi-bhede nekkhamme abhirataṃ

examples.text: sabbasaṃyojan'ātītaṃ, vanā nibbanam'āgataṃ, kāmehi nekkhammarataṃ, muttaṃ selā'va kañcanaṃ.

38719.meaning1: intention of renunciation; thought of giving up sensual pleasure
38719.commentary: (MNa) nekkhammasaṅkapp'ādīsu kāmapaccanīk'aṭṭhena, kāmato nissaṭabhāvena vā, kāmaṃ sammasantassa uppanno'ti vā, kāmapadaghātaṃ kāmavūpasamaṃ karonto uppanno'ti vā, kāmavivittante uppanno'ti vā nekkhammasaṅkappo.

examples.text: nekkhammasaṅkappo, abyāpādasaṅkappo, avihiṃsāsaṅkappo, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sammāsaṅkappo sāsavo puññabhāgiyo upadhivepakko.

38720.meaning1: full of thoughts of renunciation; frequently thinking about giving up sensual pleasure

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena cīvarena, santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena piṇḍapātena, santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena sen'āsanena, santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārena, nekkhammasaṅkappabahulo ca viharati.

38721.meaning1: perception connected with renunciation; recognition concerned with giving up sensual pleasure
38721.commentary: (DNa) nekkhammasaññādayopi nekkhammavitakk'ādi-sampayuttāy'eva. tasmā tāsam'pi tath'eva kām'āvacar'ādibhāvo veditabbo.

examples.text: saññā'pi hi bahū anekavidhā nānappakārakā. nekkhammasaññā, abyāpādasaññā, avihiṃsāsaññā, itosamuṭṭhānā kusalā saṅkappā.

38722.meaning1: connected with renunciation; related to giving up sensual pleasure; (comm) connected with insight

examples.text: chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cha gehasitāni somanassāni, cha nekkhammasitāni somanassāni, cha gehasitāni domanassāni, cha nekkhammasitāni domanassāni, cha gehasitā upekkhā, cha nekkhammasitā upekkhā.
papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.

38723.meaning1: ascetic pleasure; happiness of renunciation; pleasure of giving up sensual pleasure
38723.meaning2: happiness of leading a holy life

examples.text: idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ. āsevitabbaṃ, bhāvetabbaṃ, bahulīkātabbaṃ, na bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā'ti, vadāmi.

yo kho, nāgita, na'y'imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā'ti.

38724.meaning1: supported by renunciation; dependent on giving up sensual pleasure; (comm) connected with insight
38724.commentary: (NPa) yaṃ nekkhammassitaṃ domanassan'ti-ādi kusalā'ti vuttataṇhāya sarūpadassan'atthaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cha gehasitāni somanassāni, cha nekkhammassitāni somanassāni, cha gehasitāni domanassāni, cha nekkhammasitāni domanassāni, cha gehasitā upekkhā, cha nekkhammasitā upekkhā. tattha katamāni cha gehasitāni somanassāni?

38725.meaning1: thought of renunciation; thought of letting go of sensual pleasure

examples.text: kāmavitakkaṃ ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bahulam'anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, pahāsi nekkhammavitakkaṃ, kāmavitakkaṃ bahulam'akāsi, tassa taṃ kāmavitakkāya cittaṃ namati.

nekkhammavitakkena, abyāpādavitakkena, avihiṃsāvitakkena, paññavā hoti ajaḷo anelamūgo, imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ araññavanappatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevitun'ti.

38726.meaning1: habituated to renunciation; established in giving up sensual pleasure; firmly entrenched in giving up the world
38726.commentary: (ANa) nekkhamm'ādhimutto'ti'ādi sabbaṃ arahattavasen'eva vuttaṃ. arahattañ'hi sabbakilesehi nikkhantattā nekkhammaṃ

examples.text: so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti, nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti, pavivek'ādhimutto hoti, abyāpajj'ādhimutto hoti, taṇhākkhay'ādhimutto hoti, upādānakkhay'ādhimutto hoti, asammoh'ādhimutto hoti.

38727.meaning1: enjoying renunciation; taking delight in giving up sensual pleasure

examples.text: tatra bhikkhu vivekaninnena cittena vivekapoṇena vivekapabbhārena vivek'aṭṭhena nekkhamm'ābhiratena añña'd'atthu uyyojanika-paṭisaṃyuttaṃ'y'eva kathaṃ kattā hoti

38728.meaning1: peace of renunciation; tranquillity of giving up sensual pleasure; (comm) stilling of the defilements
38728.commentary: (DHPa) nekkhamm'ūpasame ratā'ti ettha pabbajjā nekkhamman'ti na gahetabbā, kilesavūpasamanibbānaratiṃ pana sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: ye jhānapasutā dhīrā, nekkhamm'ūpasame ratā, devā'pi tesaṃ pihayanti, sambuddhānaṃ satīmataṃ.
adhivāsetu dāni, bhante, bhagavā, adhivāsetu sugato, adhivāsanakālo dāni, bhante, bhagavato. yena yen'eva dāni bhagavā gamissati taṃninnā'va gamissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca.
atha kho rājagahako negamo sālavatiṃ kumāriṃ gaṇikaṃ vuṭṭhāpesi.
yāva kāsijanapado, suṅko me tatthako ahu, taṃ katvā negamo agghaṃ, aḍḍhen'agghaṃ ṭhapesi maṃ.

38731.meaning1: townspeople and country people; urban and rural inhabitants

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ, tāta, dhammaṃ'y'eva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhamm'ādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahassu antojanasmiṃ balakāyasmiṃ khattiyesu anuyantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamajānapadesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu migapakkhīsu.

38732.commentary: (DNa) gahapatinecayikā'ti gahapati mahāsālā. tesañ'hi mahādhanadhaññanicayo, tasmā necayikā'ti vuccanti. (DNt) nicayanaṃ dhanadhaññānaṃ sañcayanaṃ nicayo, tattha niyuttā'ti necayikā, gahapati eva necayikā gahapatinecayikā.

examples.text: dhaṃsī ca, pagabbho ca, tintiṇo ca, mahagghaso ca, luddo ca, akāruṇiko ca, dubbalo ca, oravitā ca, muṭṭhassati ca, necayiko ca, imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgato kāko. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu.
ye rañño janapade gahapatinecayikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca, te rājā mahāvijito āmantesi, icchām'ahaṃ, bho, mahāyaññaṃ yajituṃ.

38733.grammar: pr, from na ejati, neg, intrans (+loc)
38733.meaning1: is unshaken; is not moved; is unperturbed; is unruffled (by)

examples.text: yena naṃ vajjuṃ puthujjanā, atho samaṇabrāhmaṇā, taṃ tassa apurakkhataṃ, tasmā vādesu n'ejati.

38734.meaning1: (gram) should be joined; should be connected (to)

examples.text: naye paraṃ yutte'ti assaro byañjano par'akkharaṃ netabbo. lok'aggo.

38735.meaning2: should be led, should be guided, should be carried away

38736.synonym: anunetar, nāyaka, ninnetar, netta, vināyaka, venayika
38736.commentary: (DNa) netā'ti taṃ taṃ atthaṃ dassento paññāya netā. vividhāni kāraṇāni dassento netī'ti vinetā. punappunaṃ netī'ti anunetā.

examples.text: saṅgāhako mittakaro, vadaññū vītamaccharo, netā vinetā anunetā, tādiso labhate yasaṃ.
yassa jālinī visattikā, taṇhā n'atthi kuhiñci netave, taṃ buddham'anantagocaraṃ, apadaṃ kena padena nessatha.
n'eso dhammo n'eso vinayo n'etaṃ satthusāsanan'ti
sutavā ca kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako… rūpaṃ n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti samanupassati.

38739.grammar: idiom, ind + pron + nt + pr, neg
38739.meaning1: this is impossible; this is illogical; this is not plausible

examples.text: att'atthaṃ vā ñassati par'atthaṃ vā ñassati ubhay'atthaṃ vā ñassati uttariṃ vā manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ sacchikarissatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
upadhi dukkhassa mūlan'ti, iti viditvā nirupadhi upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto upadhismiṃ vā kāyaṃ upasaṃharissati cittaṃ vā uppādessatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

38740.grammar: idiom, ind + pron + pr + ind + pr, neg
38740.meaning1: I don't deny it; I don't say that's not true
38740.meaningLit: I don't say there isn't this

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇesu janapadesu dhovanaṃ nāma. tattha hoti annam'pi pānam'pi khajjam'pi bhojjam'pi leyyam'pi peyyam'pi naccam'pi gītam'pi vāditam'pi. atth'etaṃ, bhikkhave, dhovanaṃ, n'etaṃ n'atthī'ti vadāmi.

38741.meaning1: section on 'this possibility does not exist'

38742.meaning1: not of this kind; not of this type; not like this
38742.commentary: (SNPa) yādiso ayaṃ pacchā vutto maggadūsī, itare'pi sabbe n'etādisā'ti ñatvā iti disvā evaṃ pāpaṃ karontam'pi etaṃ pāpabhikkhuṃ disvā.

examples.text: ete ca paṭivijjhi yo gahaṭṭho, sutavā ariyasāvako sapañño, sabbe n'etādisā'ti ñatvā, iti disvā na hāpeti tassa saddhā.
tasmā pattapuṭass'eva, ñatvā sampākam'attano, asante n'upaseveyya, sante seveyya paṇḍito, asanto nirayaṃ nenti, santo pāpenti suggatin'ti.
seyyathā'pi saha bhaṇḍena gahitacoraṃ, vadhetha nan'ti rañño āṇāya rājapurisā bandhitvā catukke catukke pahārasatāni dentā āghātanaṃ nenti.

38744.meaning1: draws a conclusion; understands; takes as

examples.text: iminā tvaṃ dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atīt'ānāgate nayaṃ nehi

38745.grammar: pr, from na eti, neg, trans (+acc)
38745.meaning1: does not enter; does not go (into)

examples.text: ninhāya sabbapāpakāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca sabbaloke, devamanussesu kappiyesu, kappaṃ n'eti tam'āhu nhātako'ti.
vītagedho amaccharī, na ussesu vadate muni, na samesu na omesu, kappaṃ n'eti akappiyo.

38746.grammar: pron, masc nom & acc pl of na eta, neg

examples.text: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kām'ūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā. api ca kho, bhikkhave, n'ete kāmā kāmaguṇā nām'ete ariyassa vinaye vuccanti. saṅkapparāgo purisassa kāmo.
bhūtapubbaṃ pūraṇo kassapo bāhā paggayha kandanto na labhati, appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddam'akattha. n'ete, bhavante, pucchanti, amhe ete pucchanti, mayam'etesaṃ byākarissāmā'ti.
gunnaṃ ce taramānānaṃ, jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavo, sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchanti, nette jimhaṃ gate sati.

38748.synonym: akkha, akkhi, cakkhu, dassana, nayana, locana

examples.text: jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.
aṭṭhapadakatā kesā, nettā añjanamakkhitā, alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.

38749.commentary: (SNa) sārathī'va nettāni gahetvā'ti yathā samappavattesu sindhavesu odhastapatodo sārathī sabbayottāni gahetvā acodento avārento tiṭṭhati

examples.text: tatra bhikkhavo samādahaṃsu, cittam'attano ujukaṃ akaṃsu, sārathī'va nettāni gahetvā, indriyāni rakkhanti paṇḍitā'ti.

38750.meaning1: with eyes; having (a certain kind of) eyes; -eyed

examples.text: abhinīlanetto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
pasannanetto sumukho, brahā uju patāpavā, majjhe samaṇasaṅghassa, ādicco'va virocasi.

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… vamanaṃ virecanaṃ uddhaṃvirecanaṃ adhovirecanaṃ sīsavirecanaṃ kaṇṇatelaṃ nettatappanaṃ natthukammaṃ añjanaṃ paccañjanaṃ sālākiyaṃ sallakattiyaṃ dārakatikicchā mūlabhesajjānaṃ anuppadānaṃ osadhīnaṃ paṭimokkho
āhāranettippabhavaṃ, n'ālaṃ tadabhinandituṃ, tassa nissaraṇaṃ santaṃ, atakk'āvacaraṃ dhuvaṃ.
pariciṇṇo mayā satthā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ, ohito garuko bhāro, bhavanetti samūhatā.

38754.commentary: (MNa) dhammanetti samanumajjitabbā'ti dhammarajju anumajjitabbā ñāṇena ghaṃsitabbā upaparikkhitabbā. sā pan'esā dhammanetti iti kho vaccha ime dasa dhammā akusalā dasa dhammā kusalā'ti evaṃ mahāvacchagottasutte (ma. ni. 2.194) āgatā'ti vuttā. sā eva vā hotu, yo vā idha dhammo'ti ca vinayo ca vutto.

examples.text: teh'ānanda, bhikkhūhi sabbeh'eva samaggehi sannipatitabbaṃ. sannipatitvā dhammanetti samanumajjitabbā. dhammanettiṃ samanumajjitvā yathā tattha sameti tathā taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametabbaṃ.
jātaṃ bhūtaṃ samuppannaṃ, kataṃ saṅkhatam'addhuvaṃ. jarāmaraṇasaṅghāṭaṃ, roganīḷaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ. āhāranettippabhavaṃ, n'ālaṃ tadabhinandituṃ.
bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata, bhante, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī'ti.
udakañ'hi nayanti nettikā, usukārā namayanti tejanaṃ, dāruṃ namayanti tacchakā, attānaṃ damayanti subbatā.

38761.meaning2: who has cut the rope (of craving)

38762.grammar: ind, adv, from na ima, neg
38762.meaning1: not here; not in this place; not in this case; not in this regard

examples.text: ye ca yaññā nirārambhā, yajanti anukulaṃ sadā, aj'eḷakā ca gāvo ca, vividhā n'ettha haññare, etaṃ sammaggatā yaññaṃ, upayanti mah'esino.

38763.meaning1: (of an issue) getting over; getting past
38763.commentary: (VINa) na netthāraṃ vattantī'ti attano nittharaṇamaggaṃ na paṭipajjanti.

examples.text: so bhikkhūhi vuccamāno aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, na sammā vattati, na lomaṃ pāteti, na netthāraṃ vattati, yena saṅgho attamano hoti taṃ karomī'ti n'āha.

te saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakatā na sammā vattanti, na lomaṃ pātenti, na netthāraṃ vattanti, na bhikkhū khamāpenti, akkosanti paribhāsanti chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpenti, pakkamanti'pi, vibbhamanti'pi.

38764.meaning2: clears himself from blame; purifies himself from fault; becomes acquitted

examples.text: na sammā vattati, na lomaṃ pāteti, na netthāraṃ vattati, yena saṅgho attamano hoti taṃ karomī'ti n'āha.
disvān'assa etadahosi, na kho me taṃ patirūpaṃ yaṃ me pekkhamānassa manussabhūto kālaṅ'kareyya, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ dārakaṃ assamaṃ netvā āpādeyyaṃ poseyyaṃ vaḍḍheyyan'ti.

atha naṃ āha, amma, kāḷi imasmiṃ nagare pañca sakaṭasatāni paccūsakāle uṭṭhāya vāṇijjāya gacchanti, tvaṃ imaṃ netvā cakkamagge nipajjāpehi, goṇā vā naṃ maddissanti, cakkā vā chindissanti, pavattiṃ c'assa ñatvāva āgaccheyyāsī'ti.
atha kho naṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālaṃ puttā gharaṃ netvā nhāpetvā paccekaṃ dussayugena acchādesuṃ.

38768.meaning1: skilfulness; astuteness; carefulness; circumspection; being adept

examples.text: saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ satimā bhavissati, paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatam'pi cirabhāsitam'pi saritā anussaritā.

seyyathā'pi dovāriko hoti paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā, evam'evaṃ kho ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatam'pi cirabhāsitam'pi saritā anussaritā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, silāyūpo soḷasa kukkuko. tass'assu aṭṭha kukku heṭṭhā nemaṅ'gamā, aṭṭha kukku uparinemassa.

seyyathā'pi rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhī abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. evam'evaṃ kho ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ

38771.meaning1: sunk into the pit; buried in the hole

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, silāyūpo soḷasa kukkuko. tass'assu aṭṭha kukku heṭṭhā nemaṅ'gamā, aṭṭha kukku uparinemassa.

yassa kassaci, āvuso, bhikkhuno ime pāpakā akusalā icch'āvacarā pahīnā dissanti c'eva sūyanti ca, kiñ'c'āpi so hoti gām'antavihārī nemantaniko gahapaticīvaradharo, atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti.

38774.meaning1: rim of a wheel; tyre; felly; felloe

examples.text: idh'ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa tadah'uposathe pannarase sīsaṃ nhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pāturahosi sahass'āraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.
tena kho pana samayena samīti yānakāraputto rathassa nemiṃ tacchati. tam'enaṃ paṇḍuputto ājīvako purāṇayānakāraputto paccupaṭṭhito hoti.

38776.meaning1: fortune teller; diviner; prognosticator; who can read signs

examples.text: addasaṃsu kho, bhikkhave, nemittā brāhmaṇā vipassiṃ kumāraṃ, disvā bandhumantaṃ rājānaṃ etadavocuṃ, attamano, deva, hohi, mahesakkho te putto uppanno, lābhā te, mahārāja, suladdhaṃ te, mahārāja, yassa te kule evarūpo putto uppanno.
ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhu na kamati.
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, vassassa antarāyā, yaṃ nemittakā na jānanti, yattha nemittakānaṃ cakkhu na kamati. katame pañca?
yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te kuhakā ca honti, lapakā ca nemittikā ca nippesikā ca, lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīṃsitāro ca

38781.construction:
ni > ne + √mā > mi + tta + *ika + tā
nemittika + tā

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, micchāājīvo? kuhanā, lapanā, nemittikatā, nippesikatā, lābhena lābhaṃ nijigisanatā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, micchāājīvo.

38783.commentary: (MNa) sahassaṃ nemimaṇḍalānaṃ volokeyyā'ti pāsādapariveṇe nābhiyā patiṭṭhitānaṃ nemivaṭṭiyā nemivaṭṭiṃ āhacca ṭhitānaṃ nemimaṇḍalānaṃ sahassaṃ vātapānaṃ vivaritvā olokeyya, tassa nābhiyo'pi pākaṭā honti, arā'pi ar'antarāni'pi nemiyo'pi.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso sāriputta, cakkhumā puriso uparipāsādavaragato sahassaṃ nemimaṇḍalānaṃ volokeyya. evam'eva kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sahassaṃ lokānaṃ voloketi.

38784.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: dve jālino munino aṭṭhako ca, atha kosallo buddho atho subāhu, upanemiso nemiso santacitto, sacco tatho virajo paṇḍito ca.
api c'āhaṃ āyasmato nemisaddena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhito'ti.
samantanemīni sahass'arāni ca, byākaṃsu veyyañjanikā samāgatā, disvā kumāraṃ satapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, parivāravā hessati sattumaddano.

38787.meaning1: could be led astray; could be misguided (by)

examples.text: na kappayanti na purekkharonti, dhammā'pi tesaṃ na paṭicchitāse, na brāhmaṇo sīlavatena neyyo, pāraṅ'gato na pacceti tādī'ti.
na vedagū diṭṭhiyā na mutiyā, sa mānam'eti na hi tam'mayo so, na kammunā no'pi sutena neyyo, anūpanīto sa nivesanesu.

38788.meaning1: could be led on; could be guided further; could be advised
38788.commentary: (ANa) yassa puggalassa uddesato paripucchato yonisomanasikaroto kalyāṇamitte sevato bhajato payirupāsato anupubbena dhamm'ābhisamayo hoti, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo neyyo.

examples.text: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.
cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? ugghaṭitaññū, vipañcitaññū, neyyo, padaparamo, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

38789.meaning1: should be inferred; should be deduced; should be interpreted; implicit
38789.commentary: (ANa) neyy'atthaṃ sutt'antan'ti yassa attho netabbo, taṃ netabb'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti. katame dve? yo ca neyy'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ nīt'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpeti, yo ca nīt'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ neyy'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpeti. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhantī'ti.

38790.meaning1: could be known; could be understood; knowable; cognizable
38790.commentary: (MNa) kiṃ neyyan'ti kiṃ jānitabbaṃ. yaṃkiñci neyyaṃ nāma atthi dhamman'ti-ādīsu (mahāni. 69) hi jānitabbaṃ neyyan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: nissaṭṭhena āvuso, pañcahi indriyehi parisuddhena manoviññāṇena ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ neyyan'ti.

38791.meaning1: with meaning to be inferred; whose meaning requires interpretation; with implicit meaning; with inconclusive meaning
38791.commentary: (ANa) neyy'atthaṃ sutt'antan'ti yassa attho netabbo, taṃ netabb'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti. katame dve? yo ca neyy'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ nīt'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpeti, yo ca nīt'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ neyy'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpeti. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhantī'ti.

38792.meaning2: name of a river; modern day Lilaja river, a tributary of the Ganges
38792.commentary: (UDa) nerañjarāyā'ti nelaṃ jalam'assā'ti nelañ'jalāyā'ti vattabbe lakārassa rakāraṃ katvā nerañjarāyā'ti vuttaṃ, kaddama-sevālapaṇak'ādi-dosarahita-salilāyā'ti attho. keci nīlajalāyā'ti vattabbe nerañjarāyā'ti vuttan'ti vadanti. nāmam'eva vā etaṃ etissā nadiyā'ti veditabbaṃ. tassā nadiyā tīre yattha bhagavā vihāsi, taṃ dassetuṃ bodhirukkhamūle'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: bhagavā uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā nerañjarāya tīre bodhirukkhamūle
atthāya vata me buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ agā, yass'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna, micchādiṭṭhiṃ vivajjayiṃ.

38793.meaning1: denizen of hell; inhabitant of hell

examples.text: tav'eva hetū asurā bhavāmase, tvaṃmūlakaṃ nerayikā bhavāmase, atho tiracchānagatā'pi ekadā, petattanaṃ vā'pi tav'eva vāhasā.
katamā ca, sāriputta, opapātikā yoni? devā, nerayikā, ekacce ca manussā, ekacce ca vinipātikā, ayaṃ vuccati, sāriputta, opapātikā yoni.

38794.meaning1: born in hell; living in hell; related to hell
38794.commentary: (ANa) seyyathā'pi sattā nerayikā'ti yathā niraye nibbattasattā ek'antadukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyanti, evaṃ vediyatī'ti attho.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ sabyābajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyābajjhā phassā phusanti. so sabyābajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyābajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti ek'antadukkhaṃ, seyyathā'pi sattā nerayikā.
nerayikena dukkhena phandamānaṃ, tiracchānayonikena dukkhena phandamānaṃ

38795.meaning1: destined for hell; to be reborn in hell
38795.meaning2: one doomed to suffer in the hell

examples.text: sace pana te samaṇo gotamo evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākaroti, na, rājakumāra, tathāgato taṃ vācaṃ bhāseyya yā sā vācā paresaṃ appiyā amanāpā'ti, tam'enaṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, atha kiñ'carahi te, bhante, devadatto byākato, āpāyiko devadatto, nerayiko devadatto, kappaṭṭho devadatto, atekiccho devadatto'ti?

38796.meaning1: name of a mythical mountain at the centre of the universe

38797.commentary: (JAa) nerū'ti himavati eko suvaṇṇapabbato, taṃ upagatā kākā'pi suvaṇṇavaṇṇā'va honti.

38799.grammar: pr, caus of na īrati, neg, trans (+acc)
38799.meaning1: does not agitate; does not arouse

examples.text: sace n'eresi attānaṃ, kaṃso upahato yathā, esa patto'si nibbānaṃ, sārambho te na vijjati.
